evidence_digest: The strict bounded dialog schema and launch-scoped NativeDialogSession already exist. Public wiring is absent. Explicit surface/generation values must be compared to the active snapshot or window fallback and fail closed on mismatch without echoing current values; omitted values may derive from active state. Accept/cancel require authorize=true; detect remains observational. Add one public tool, port/stub wiring, focused contract/runtime coverage, and contract/security documentation without exposing provider or grant material.
